prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Garruk Mawsuture. Character visual motifs: hunched iron-jawed smith operating a strapped cage forge, rotating trap anvils and huge riveted gauntlets; no hook/rot/dismember.
TOP LEFT: Scrap Appetite. Ability concept: destroyed enemy deployables or spent jaw traps grant Scrap, maximum 3, each increasing next jaw width by 6 GU.
TOP RIGHT: Set Jaws. Ability concept: plants two hinged iron teeth on ground 50 GU apart, 2 HP each. After 0.55 s, crossing the gap closes them for a 0.5 s root **only once**, then they jam open. Units can attack or skirt them.
BOTTOM LEFT: Forge Drag. Ability concept: drags one installed tooth 45 GU along a visible chain, scraping a narrow damage lane and reopening a previously triggered jaw with half strength.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Factory Floor. Ability concept: lays three staggered **jaw lanes** around Garruk for 5 s. Their timing is sequential (audible clacks), leaving safe corridors; no suppression, unit grab, or poison aura.
